agent_profile.title: Analista de Requisitos do TJCE para PDS Unificado
agent_profile.portrait: The Analista de Requisitos TJCE is a methodical, precision-driven judicial requirements analyst who refuses to tolerate ambiguity. Speaking in formal Portuguese with the vocabulary of Brazilian court systems, this agent stops mid-flow to interrogate vague requirements rather than fill gaps with assumptions. It produces the four mandatory PDS Unificado artifacts with ironclad traceability: every rule traces to a story, every message traces to a rule, and no cell is left to TODO.

findings.title: No progression condition keywords in capability file
No config header with language variables
Missing menu-code in frontmatter
Hardcoded output path bypasses configurable output_folder

narrative: This agent demonstrates strong domain design with a rigorous traceability model and clean prompt architecture (2,809 tokens, zero waste patterns). Its primary opportunity is hardening the lifecycle beyond initial generation: adding progression markers to capability files, building context management for large systems, and extracting deterministic validation work into scripts.

opportunities.name: Missing Progression and Flow Control Markers
opportunities.description: The capability file generate-requirements.md contains meaningful procedural logic — two execution branches, a four-step sequential generation order, and a self-validation gate — but expresses all of this through natural language structure rather than explicit conditional keywords. Without explicit markers, automated tooling cannot parse the flow and future maintainers may miss branching logic.
opportunities.impact: Improves parsability for tooling, reduces maintainer confusion, and makes the generation flow explicit and auditable.
opportunities.action: Add explicit progression markers to generate-requirements.md at three decision points: (1) 'If interview mode...' / 'If PRD mode...' at the branch, (2) 'Proceed to [next artifact] only when [current artifact] is complete' at generation steps, (3) 'Do not output artifacts until all checklist items pass' at the validation gate.

findings.title: No progression condition keywords found in generate-requirements.md
findings.detail: Progression is expressed through section headers and bullet structure rather than explicit conditional keywords

findings.title: No progression keywords in artifact-templates.md (false positive)
findings.detail: Template reference file — not a capability file. Scanner category error; no action needed for this file.

findings.title: Progression markers absent from capability file
findings.detail: Behavior is conditional and sequential but uses natural language structure rather than explicit if/proceed/complete markers

opportunities.name: Context Pressure and Session Resilience Gaps
opportunities.description: Multiple scanners identified that the agent has no strategy for managing context growth in large systems or recovering from interrupted sessions. Interview transcripts are carried verbatim through all four generation phases with no summarization step. There is no checkpointing, no partial output recovery, and no atomic write guarantee.
opportunities.impact: Prevents degraded output quality for large systems, enables session resumption for multi-day requirements gathering, and reduces context waste during generation.
opportunities.action: Add three mechanisms to generate-requirements.md: (1) a transition step between interview and generation that synthesizes dialogue into a compact requirements brief, (2) guidance to write each artifact to disk immediately and reference files for cross-artifact checks, (3) an activation check in SKILL.md to scan for existing partial output and offer resume behavior.

findings.title: No context pressure guard for large systems
findings.detail: For systems with 50+ US and 100+ RN, artifact tables can consume significant context with no mitigation strategy

findings.title: Interview transcript not summarized before generation
findings.detail: Full conversation history accumulates in context before generation begins; no compression step exists

findings.title: No partial output recovery on session restart
findings.detail: If interrupted mid-generation, the agent cannot resume; restarts always start from input detection

findings.title: No re-entry path after partial session
findings.detail: Sessions are stateless; no mechanism to save interview progress and resume later

findings.title: Validation failure after generation with no rollback
findings.detail: Files may be left in inconsistent state if self-validation catches failures after partial writes

opportunities.name: Lifecycle Gaps: No Update or Review Capabilities
opportunities.description: The agent excels at creating requirements from scratch but has no flow for updating existing artifacts, validating third-party artifacts, or handling iterative review cycles. Real projects evolve and without these flows the agent is discarded after initial generation.
opportunities.impact: Extends the agent's usefulness across the full project lifecycle, not just the initial specification phase.
opportunities.action: Add two new capabilities: (1) an update mode that detects existing artifacts and presents changes as diffs before applying, (2) a validation-only mode that audits existing artifacts for traceability and completeness without regenerating. Reference these in the Capabilities table.

findings.title: No flow for updating already-generated artifacts
findings.detail: Agent defines creation well but has no incremental update mechanism for evolving projects

findings.title: No capability for autonomous validation of existing artifacts
findings.detail: A senior analyst persona should be able to review and audit third-party work

findings.title: No diff view for iterative sessions
findings.detail: Running on PRD v2 generates complete new artifacts with no indication of what changed

findings.title: Missing review mode in three-mode architecture
findings.detail: Interactive and headless modes exist but no review mode for analyzing existing artifacts

opportunities.name: Deterministic Validation Delegated to LLM
opportunities.description: Eleven deterministic operations are currently performed by the LLM at an estimated cost of 2,250-3,200 tokens per invocation. These include ID sequence validation, cross-reference integrity checks, placeholder detection, and message type coverage — all pure string/set operations.
opportunities.impact: Extracting to scripts eliminates ~2,500 tokens of LLM tax per run, improves validation reliability, and enables CI integration.
opportunities.action: Create a scripts/ directory with post-processing validators. Start with the three P0 cross-reference scripts: validate-ids.py, check-rn-us-refs.py, check-msg-rn-refs.py (~1,050 tokens saved, implementable in under an hour).

findings.title: Placeholder/empty cell detection delegated to LLM (SO-007)
findings.detail: String matching against fixed forbidden patterns costing ~250 tokens

findings.title: Message type coverage check delegated to LLM (SO-006)

findings.title: Assumptions file compilation delegated to LLM (SO-009)
findings.detail: Regex scan for [ASSUMIDO] tags and file generation costing ~300 tokens

opportunities.name: Missing Soft Gates and User Experience Polish
opportunities.description: The agent lacks soft gates at critical transition points: no scope confirmation before generation, no coverage map after reading a PRD, no onboarding preamble for first-timers, and no graceful handling of 'I don't know' answers during interviews.
opportunities.impact: Reduces mid-generation rework, improves first-timer onboarding, and prevents scope misunderstandings.
opportunities.action: Add three mechanisms: (1) a pre-generation scope confirmation, (2) a coverage map after loading a PRD showing which areas are complete vs. incomplete, (3) a deferred item queue for unknown answers during interviews.

findings.title: No soft gate elicitation before generation
findings.detail: Agent begins generation as soon as it believes it has enough information without confirming scope with user

findings.title: No intent-before-ingestion pattern when reading documents
findings.detail: In interactive mode with file input, the agent reads and proceeds without stating its interpretation first

findings.title: No 'I don't know' recovery path during interviews
findings.detail: Interview has no graceful handling of provisional answers; user who says 'nao sei' is stuck

findings.title: No onboarding preamble for first-timers
findings.detail: First-time users receive no explanation of the four PDS Unificado artifacts or interview process

findings.title: No scope creep warning during interview
findings.detail: If user introduces new actors or areas mid-interview, scope expands silently with no alert

strengths.title: Rigorous traceability model
strengths.detail: The bidirectional traceability chain (US to RN to MSG) with self-validation is a genuine domain design strength. The generation order enforces dependency correctness — each artifact informs the next.

strengths.title: Zero-waste prompt architecture
strengths.detail: 2,809 tokens across three files with zero waste patterns, zero back-references, zero wall-of-text, and zero suggestive loading. Every instruction maps to an observable agent behavior.

strengths.title: Strong persona-capability alignment
strengths.detail: The identity (methodical, precise, ambiguity-averse) directly drives behavioral rules — the no-placeholder prohibition, the stop-and-ask stance, and the self-validation gate all flow from the declared persona.

strengths.title: Clean intelligence placement
strengths.detail: SKILL.md handles identity and routing, generate-requirements.md handles execution logic, artifact-templates.md handles format. No cross-contamination between layers.

strengths.title: Well-specified headless mode
strengths.detail: Entry condition, input resolution, fallback error behavior, mid-generation ambiguity handling via [ASSUMIDO], and audit trail via assumptions.md — the headless path is complete.

strengths.title: Bilingual architecture done right
strengths.detail: English for structural/meta instructions, Portuguese for domain content and persona voice, with consistent boundaries throughout the corpus.

strengths.title: Correct delegation of procedural detail
strengths.detail: SKILL.md avoids over-specification by delegating all interview flow, generation order, and validation checklists to reference files.

structure.assessment: All six required SKILL.md sections present in correct order. Single-capability routing table is valid with both referenced files confirmed. Frontmatter name lacks 'agent' convention and description omits 'product vision' as a trigger phrase. Output path hardcoded in generate-requirements.md bypasses configurable output_folder.

findings.title: Name 'tjce-requirements' should contain 'agent'
findings.detail: Name field does not follow the agent-{name} or {code}-agent-{name} convention

findings.title: Description missing 'product vision' trigger phrase
findings.detail: Product Vision is a mandatory output but not listed as a routing trigger in the description

findings.title: Output path not using config variable
findings.detail: Hardcoded spec/requirements/ path bypasses configurable {output_folder} variable

persona.assessment: Prompt craft is strong with excellent token efficiency (2,809 tokens, zero pathological patterns). Overview is outcome-first, Identity is behaviorally grounded, Communication Style rules are terse and LLM-actionable. Missing menu-code in reference frontmatter and single-row Capabilities table adds unnecessary ceremony.

findings.title: Missing menu-code in generate-requirements.md frontmatter
findings.detail: BMad standard reference prompt contract requires menu-code field

findings.title: Single-row Capabilities table adds structural noise
findings.detail: One capability does not benefit from table format; a single sentence would communicate identically with fewer tokens

findings.title: Overview missing theory-of-mind anchor for human caller
findings.detail: A brief model of who is calling this agent would improve interview interactions

cohesion.assessment: Persona-capability alignment is strong with 1:1 correspondence between identity traits and behavioral rules. Traceability constraints are identically stated across SKILL.md and generate-requirements.md (intentional, structurally justified). Gaps exist in post-delivery lifecycle and multi-document conflict handling.

persona_capability_alignment.notes: Identity traits (methodical, precise, ambiguity-averse) directly manifest as behavioral rules in capability files. No capabilities exceed the persona, no persona exceeds the capabilities.

findings.title: No protocol for conflicting input documents
findings.detail: When PRD contradicts a brief or multiple inputs disagree, agent has no defined disambiguation protocol

findings.title: Acceptance criteria lack structured conventions
findings.detail: User Story template includes acceptance criteria as free-form checkboxes with no granularity or coverage conventions

findings.title: No judicial glossary referenced or included
findings.detail: Agent operates in specialized judicial domain but carries no glossary; terminological consistency depends on current session only

efficiency.assessment: Adequate for its class. The sequential artifact generation order is a correctness requirement, not an efficiency failure. Primary opportunities are eager resource loading (eliminating two deferred reads) and context management for large systems. No blocking or critical findings.

findings.title: Reference files loaded lazily; could be loaded eagerly at activation
findings.detail: generate-requirements.md and artifact-templates.md could be loaded in parallel with config at activation

findings.title: Self-validation is a sequential checklist; could be single-pass audit
findings.detail: Seven validation checks are independent and could be evaluated as a single-pass batch

experience.assessment: Six user archetypes reveal recurring dead-ends in the interactive path, assumption walls in headless mode, and meaningful delight opportunities. The most critical gap is the absence of a soft gate at interview start — the agent can race into generation with insufficient information.

journeys.summary: Product manager from TJCE IT unfamiliar with PDS Unificado artifacts enters an interview with no explanation of what will be produced or how long it will take.
friction_points: No explanation of the four output artifacts
bright_spots: Agent's stop-and-ask behavior prevents runaway generation
Formal Portuguese register matches institutional context

journeys.summary: Senior analyst who has used the skill on 5+ projects wants fast generation with minimal interruption but cannot skip or customize the interview flow.
friction_points: Cannot skip interview when providing verbal brief
No batch mode for multiple systems
bright_spots: Lean prompt architecture means fast loading
Headless mode available for repeat workflows

journeys.summary: Developer asked to run the requirements tool without domain knowledge enters an interview they cannot meaningfully answer.
friction_points: No detection that respondent lacks domain authority
No redirect suggestion to appropriate stakeholder
bright_spots: Agent's ambiguity-halt behavior surfaces gaps quickly

journeys.summary: Analyst for a minimal single-actor read-only system finds the four-message-type constraint forces artificial confirmations.
friction_points: Four message type constraint cannot be relaxed with justification
Single-actor system receives no explicit actor enumeration step
bright_spots: Traceability model still works correctly for small systems

journeys.summary: CI pipeline runs headless against an auto-generated PRD from Jira export with mixed languages, duplicates, and inconsistent terminology.
friction_points: No input normalization or terminology mapping
Duplicate sections may produce conflicting rules
Mixed-language input may leave untranslated fragments

journeys.summary: DevOps engineer integrating the skill into CI/CD cannot distinguish success from failure states and lacks machine-readable output.
friction_points: No --dry-run mode for validation without generation
bright_spots: Headless flag exists as automation entry point

autonomous.notes: Headless mode exists with assumption flagging and audit trail, but lacks quality scoring, confidence gradients, exit code semantics, and input validation needed for true CI/CD integration.

findings.title: Multiple PRDs in planning_artifacts directory has undefined behavior
findings.detail: If multiple files exist in {planning_artifacts}, agent behavior is undefined — needs disambiguation prompt

findings.title: Ambiguity questions lack source text quotes
findings.detail: When raising ambiguity, the specific triggering source text is not quoted — user must hunt for context

scripts.assessment: Eleven deterministic operations identified as script candidates, representing 2,250-3,200 tokens of LLM tax per invocation. No scripts/ directory currently exists. The three highest-value extractions (ID validation, RN-US cross-ref, MSG-RN cross-ref) save ~1,050 tokens combined and are implementable in under an hour.

findings.title: Config loader could be a pre-processing script (SO-002)
findings.detail: YAML parsing, merging, and variable resolution are fully deterministic; ~200 tokens saved

findings.title: Input file scanner could be a pre-processing script (SO-001)
findings.detail: File enumeration and type detection are deterministic; ~150 tokens saved

findings.title: N/A exception justification validator could be a script (SO-011)
findings.detail: Pattern matching for N/A justification format is deterministic; ~150 tokens saved

recommendations.action: Add explicit progression markers (if/proceed/complete) to generate-requirements.md at the three main decision points: interview vs. PRD branch, sequential generation gates, and validation gate.
Build context management: add interview summarization step, write-to-disk-first guidance for large systems, and partial output recovery at activation.
Extract the three highest-value validation scripts (validate-ids.py, check-rn-us-refs.py, check-msg-rn-refs.py) into a scripts/post/ directory, saving ~1,050 tokens per invocation.
Add soft gates: pre-generation scope confirmation, coverage map after reading PRD, and deferred item queue for unknown answers during interviews.
Add incremental update and validation-only capabilities to extend the agent across the full project lifecycle.
Add menu-code field to generate-requirements.md frontmatter for BMad standards compliance.
Replace hardcoded spec/requirements/ path in generate-requirements.md with {output_folder}/requirements/ to respect config overrides.
Rename skill to tjce-agent-requirements to follow the {code}-agent-{name} naming convention, updating directory and all internal references.
